Q5704.reason: Common-law burglary requires a nighttime breaking and entering of another's dwelling with intent to commit a felony; daytime is the opposite of that element.

Q5705.reason: Supra-orbital pressure, trapezius squeeze, and sternal rub are central painful stimuli; pressure on the finger pulp is a peripheral stimulus.

Q5711.reason: Misrepresentation requires reliance causing pecuniary loss; the pedestrian rejected the offer and recovered a full verdict, so the statement caused no monetary loss.
